title: wolfssl_ecdh_agree: -EINVAL for PUBLIC key should be -ENOKEY
description: wolfssl_ecdh_agree returns -EINVAL when ctx->key_type==CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC. The correct errno for 'this key cannot perform this operation' is -ENOKEY (Required key not available), not -EINVAL (Invalid argument). -EINVAL is for malformed parameters. wolfssl_ecdsa_sign correctly uses -ENOKEY. Fix the agree path to match.
